verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's README documents launching the local model server directly from the command line with `llama serve -hf <model>`. A built-in web UI runs against that server, and there is a dedicated Server section, so the core start-from-CLI story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of stopping or managing the server lifecycle (stop/restart/daemon controls), and independent hands-on corroboration of the server CLI workflow.
